fusions.name: Troop Display
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with both fists, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dominance Settled
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A pinning blow deals 22 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Pant-Hoot Rally
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Silverback's Second
fusions.desc: A bonded ape of your troop fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.4 seconds.
